title: LikenessAdapter
description: LIKENESS-SIMPLIFY-01. The subject binding for a saved style (LoRA) in the household library. subject_person_id is a household adult the style looks like, or null for "Nobody (not a real person)". A style of a minor or of anyone who is not an eligible living household adult is refused at import and never has a record. A subject-linked style is always adult-only. The household likeness option controls whether household members may make pictures, videos and songs with or of one another.

adapter_id.description: The style's id in the Stack's library for this medium.

subject_person_id.description: The household adult this style looks like, or null for nobody.

classification.description: The style's audience. Always adult-only when subject_person_id is set.

declared_by.description: The adult who added the style and answered "Who does this style look like?".

source.description: How the record came to be; this is the record provenance.
